intro: WANTED: Murkdeep! is an Alliance bounty posted on the notice board outside the inn in Auberdine. The village council seeks the death of Murkdeep, a dangerous murloc chieftain blamed for slaying a night elf Sentinel and sinking merchant vessels off Darkshore. Adventurers must march south along the mist-shrouded coast to draw out the raider and deliver justice.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A reward is being offered for the death of the murloc "Murkdeep". This foul beast is known to be responsible for the death of at least one Sentinel, and is suspected of causing the sinking of at least two cargo vessels in the waters off Darkshore!

Murkdeep was last spotted at a hutted murloc camp south of Auberdine, and is thought to be protecting the huts there. Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings adventurer - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Murkdeep?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, looks like you're here to more than just inquire! The citizens will be delighted to know that tonight they will sleep a little bit more soundly and safer.
You've acted as the executioner of justice for the people of Auberdine today, friend. For that, I would like to offer you this as a suitable reward... For a true hero of the Auberdine people.
